name: Chickpea-Rice "Paella" Bake with Bell Pepper, Asparagus & Artichokes
ingredients: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then place in a medium bowl.
Drain and rinse chickpeas; add to the bowl with the rice and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; cut spears into 1-inch pieces. Place both in another medium bowl.
Preheat a large ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and thinly slice onion; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the bell pepper and asparagus.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add veggies and cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, about 2 minutes.

Once the veggies are soft, add rice, chickpeas, broth, tomato sauce, and spices to the skillet; stir to combine and bring to a boil. Once boiling, cover the skillet with an ovenproof lid or aluminum foil.
Place skillet in the oven and bake until rice has fully absorbed liquid and chickpeas are tender, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, drain and roughly chop artichoke hearts.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
When the chickpeas and rice are done, add artichokes and half of the parsley to the skillet; stir to combine the "paella." (Reserve remaining parsley for garnish.)
To serve, divide paella between plates or bowls; sprinkle with reserved parsley and squeeze lemon over top. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
